Despite a strong EBIT margin of about 26.9%, the negative working capital of approximately -7,197 million and the distress signal from an estimated Altman Z-score of 0.3 suggest high bankruptcy risk, placing the issuer in the speculative grade with high vulnerability.

DECISION: CCC+
